purpose: First bounded mobility-hold pilot targeting controller progress failure, one recovery, and later success
timing_basis: With a 15 s fixture delay, recent TurtleBot3 goals were accepted near simulation time 11.3 s. Holding planar mobility from 15 s through 27 s provides more than the frozen 10 s SimpleProgressChecker allowance after initial motion, while release should occur during or shortly after the first 1 s Wait recovery and leave sufficient action time to reach a 3 m goal.
inclusion_rule: Include in development evaluation only if simulator/capture gates pass, terminal status is succeeded, recovery history is complete, one or two unique Wait recovery attempts are recorded, and evaluator truth confirms both mobility hold and release.
mismatch_rule: Retain any valid artifact as calibration and do not alter timings, tune the same run, or relabel its family after observing the result.
evidence_boundary: The mobility intervention and its timing are evaluator-only. Robot-visible explanations may state the captured controller-progress/BT mechanism, but must not claim the physical reason for lack of progress.
